text: Design a Turing machine that accepts the language of non-palindromes over {0,1}* and analyze its state-space complexity compared to a standard decider.
Prove that the Halting Problem is undecidable using Cantor's diagonalization argument and formalize the proof in first-order logic.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP protocols, detailing their header structures, sliding-window flow control, and TCP Reno congestion control states.
Compare 3NF and BCNF normalization. Design a relational schema that is in 3NF but violates BCNF, and explain the physical dependency preservation trade-offs during decomposition.
Formulate the Raft Consensus Protocol, detailing Leader Election, Log Replication, and Safety invariants. How does it handle network partitions in Byzantine-free environments?
State the four necessary and sufficient conditions for system Deadlocks, and compare the Banker's deadlock avoidance algorithm with dynamic detection-and-recovery strategies.
Explain the architectural layout and backpropagation mechanics of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Derive the weight gradient update rules for a convolutional layer.
State Maxwell's equations in both differential and integral forms, and derive the wave equation for electromagnetic fields in a homogeneous, isotropic lossy medium.
Analyze the starting and running torque characteristics of a Three-Phase Induction Motor. Derive the slip value for maximum torque under varying rotor resistance.
Design a 4-bit synchronous up/down binary counter using JK Flip-Flops. Draw the state transition diagram, K-maps, and complete digital logic circuit implementation.
Compare Amplitude Modulation (AM) and Frequency Modulation (FM) under signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) constraints. Explain the role of superheterodyne receivers.
Formulate and prove the Superposition Theorem as applied to linear bilateral networks driven by multiple independent sinusoidal AC sources.
Analyze the frequency response of a active second-order Butterworth low-pass filter circuit. Derive the expression for the cutoff frequency and overall voltage gain.
Derive the steady-state, one-dimensional heat conduction equation in a composite hollow cylinder subject to convective boundary conditions on both inner and outer surfaces.
Derive the Navier-Stokes equations for three-dimensional, incompressible Newtonian fluid flow, detailing the physical significance of each term in the momentum equation.
Determine the critical whirling speed of a flexible shaft carrying a single centralized rotor, considering both undamped and viscous-damped boundary environments.
Analyze the ideal gas Carnot Cycle on Pressure-Volume (P-V) and Temperature-Entropy (T-s) coordinates. Prove that Carnot efficiency depends solely on source and sink temperatures.
Explain the structural mechanics and thermodynamic operations of a Four-Stroke Spark-Ignition (SI) internal combustion engine. Plot the ideal Otto cycle on P-V coordinates.
Formulate the ultimate load-carrying capacity of a shallow rectangular foundation embedded in clay soil using Terzaghi's bearing capacity theory, explaining all factors.
Differentiate statically determinate and indeterminate structures. Apply the method of consistent deformations to analyze a propped cantilever beam under uniform load.
Derive the stiffness matrix for a 2D pin-jointed truss element in global coordinates, and explain the transformation from localized element coordinates.
Explain the kinetic mechanism and biochemical reactions occurring in activated sludge processes during aerobic biological wastewater treatment.
Formulate Rankine's and Coulomb's lateral active earth pressure theories, detailing their structural assumptions regarding retaining wall friction.
Derive the McCabe-Thiele graphical method equations for binary distillation columns. Explain the physical significance of the feed line (q-line) for different feed thermal states.
Derive the integral design equation for an ideal Plug Flow Reactor (PFR) operating under steady-state, isothermal conditions with second-order reaction kinetics.
State Fick's First and Second Laws of molecular diffusion, and derive the equation for steady-state equimolar counter-diffusion of two gases in a cylindrical duct.
Formulate the design equation for a Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) operating under non-isothermal steady-state conditions, including the energy balance equation.
Explain the difference between Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids. Model the shear stress versus shear rate relationship for power-law (pseudoplastic and dilatant) fluids.
Detail the steps of Recombinant DNA Technology. Explain how restriction endonucleases, DNA ligases, and plasmid vectors are utilized to clone a target gene.
Describe the three temperature stages of the Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and explain the specific bio-molecular function of heat-stable Taq DNA Polymerase.
Analyze the oxygen mass transfer coefficient (KLa) in aerobic bioreactors. How does impeller design and aeration rate influence bioprocess yield in scaling operations?
State the Michaelis-Menten kinetic equations for single-substrate enzyme catalyzed reactions, and derive the expressions for Km and Vmax constants using Lineweaver-Burk plots.
Explain the molecular mechanism of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing, detailing the roles of guide RNA (gRNA), PAM sequences, and double-stranded DNA break repairs.
Explain the generation of aerodynamic lift using circulation theory (Kutta-Joukowski theorem) and Bernoulli's equation over a cambered NACA 4-digit airfoil.
Describe the gas-turbine cycle of a turbojet propulsion engine. Draw the ideal Brayton cycle on P-V and T-s diagrams, and derive the thermal efficiency equation.
Formulate the Tsiolkovsky Rocket Equation, detailing structural mass fraction, payload mass ratio, and specific impulse. Calculate the delta-V required for planetary escape.
State the six Keplerian orbital elements and describe how they completely specify the 3D position and velocity of a satellite in a closed elliptical orbit.
Explain the phenomenon of aeroelastic wing flutter, detailing the structural coupling between torsional stiffness and bending modes, and outline prevention methods.
